Member States were encouraged to promote whole of sector and whole of society approaches and cross-sectoral, multidisciplinary, and multi-stakeholder strategies to ensure equal access to justice for all, including through inter-ministerial coordination, formalized cooperation agreements, and collaboration with other sectors. Member states were further encouraged to ensure equal access to justice for all by meeting the needs of both victims and offenders, addressing discrimination and upholding their rights across the criminal justice chain. Addressing impunity and case backlogs through effective investigations, efficient and accountable law enforcement and justice institutions, Independent, impartial, and strengthened courts and judicial processes and efficient court management were considered as essential.
